title: The Necessity of Prayer
author: E.M. Bounds
tradition_notes: Edward McKendree Bounds was a Methodist Episcopal minister known for rising at 4am daily for three hours of prayer. He wrote nine books on prayer, most published posthumously by Fleming H. Revell. Associated with the Holiness Movement within Methodism.
